quote.needReply: This command works differently: reply to a message with !quote, don't type text with it.
quote.replyNoText: The replied message has no text to quote.

classico.needMedia: Reply to an image, video, gif or sticker (or send the command together with the media).
classico.needText: Provide the text. E.g: !classico top / bottom — you can omit one side.

simples.needMedia: Reply to an image, video, gif or sticker (or send the command together with the media).
simples.needText: Provide the text. E.g: !simples your text here.

desmot.needMedia: Reply to an image, video, gif or sticker (or send the command together with the media).
desmot.needText: Provide title and caption. E.g: !desmot title / caption — you can omit one side.

brat.needText: Provide the text (or reply to a text message). E.g: !brat your text here.

brat2.needText: Provide the text (or reply to a text message). E.g: !brat2 your text here.

papa.needTarget: Mention someone or reply to a message (or send the command with an image).
papa.noTemplate: Pope template not found. Place pope-top.png and pope-bottom.png in the plugin data folder.
